params.body:
The Deliveries page described itself in terms of plans, deliveries, categories and a fallback ("What plans promise our customers, one row per delivery..."). It did not say what the work is or what to fill in. The page now says it plainly:

- **Lead:** every customer on Intelligence gets a written read on their sector four times a year. Each row is one read: for which customer, on which sector, when it is due and who writes it. A delivered read schedules the next one three months later. A customer who leaves Intelligence has their open reads cancelled.
- **Empty state:** "No reads are due. A row appears as soon as a customer takes Intelligence." This replaces "Nothing is due."
- **Missing brief:** "without a sector yet: the customer has not filled in their brief on gentells.com."
- **Owners section:** "Category owners" is now "Who writes which sector". The fallback field is labelled **Everyone else**, and each empty sector shows "Everyone else" as its placeholder.

Only the wording changes. The field ids, the saved setting (`fallback`, `bySector`) and the behaviour are the same, so owners already saved keep their values.

Tests: `e2e/deliveries.spec.js` and `e2e/header.spec.js` pass (6 of 6). ESLint is clean on the changed file.
params.title: Say what Deliveries is in plain words
